column1: Dataset C: Vehicle and trip observation

Field observation rows are the group's own records (times standardised to 24-hour where needed; see Notes and the Data Notes tab). Rows marked 'Estimated (model)' (shaded) only fill times and stops the field work did not cover. Filter the Data source column to separate them. Estimated vehicle IDs are drawn from the vehicles operating that day on tab D and are not tracked trip by trip.
